## Problem

What team workflow or engineering question would this solve?

## Proposed interface

Describe the command, input schema, output artifact, and units.

## Verification and safety

What test, independent cross-check, and review evidence would demonstrate success? State whether
the proposal can ever interact with hardware; analysis-only behavior is preferred.
